title: A Horse with No Name
hook: Why A Horse with No Name feels *like endless desert*
question: Two-chord songs that never get boring? 👇

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Home: *E minor*. Heat, dust, no shade.

chords.name: D6/F#
chords.text: Only one voice moves: *G up to A*.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Back to E minor. *The same horizon*.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: Two chords, one drone: *it never ends*.
